# ui

UI foundation: ACP connection, faces, positions, keymap and menu.

- **Runs in:** the UI (your Emacs)
- **Source:** [lisp/ui/harness-ui.el](../../lisp/ui/harness-ui.el)
- **Loaded:** by default
- **Requires:** [acp](acp.md)
- **Required by:** [ui-access](ui-access.md), [ui-acp-remote](ui-acp-remote.md), [ui-btw](ui-btw.md), [ui-cache](ui-cache.md), [ui-cache-warm](ui-cache-warm.md), [ui-chat](ui-chat.md), [ui-children](ui-children.md), [ui-commit-msg](ui-commit-msg.md), [ui-compact](ui-compact.md), [ui-compose](ui-compose.md), [ui-config](ui-config.md), [ui-cost-compare](ui-cost-compare.md), [ui-cowboy](ui-cowboy.md), [ui-decisions](ui-decisions.md), [ui-handoff](ui-handoff.md), [ui-insights](ui-insights.md), [ui-media](ui-media.md), [ui-merge](ui-merge.md), [ui-notify](ui-notify.md), [ui-patch-review](ui-patch-review.md), [ui-pending](ui-pending.md), [ui-pet](ui-pet.md), [ui-popout](ui-popout.md), [ui-priority](ui-priority.md), [ui-quick-search](ui-quick-search.md), [ui-report](ui-report.md), [ui-review](ui-review.md), [ui-search](ui-search.md), [ui-secrets](ui-secrets.md), [ui-sessions](ui-sessions.md), [ui-slots](ui-slots.md), [ui-supervisor](ui-supervisor.md), [ui-tasks](ui-tasks.md), [ui-tool-slots-load](ui-tool-slots-load.md), [ui-tree](ui-tree.md), [ui-usage](ui-usage.md), [ui-version](ui-version.md), [ui-worktree](ui-worktree.md)

## About

Everything the presentation layer shares.  The UI never touches a
session struct: it holds one ACP connection (in-process by default,
a TCP client after `harness-connect-remote`) and renders what the
connection tells it.  This file provides:

- the connection and request helpers, plus the dispatch of incoming
  notifications and agent→client requests to hooks other UI modules
  join;
- a cache of session plists kept fresh from `_harness/session` updates;
- a cache of the harness's tools, so views name each tool by its
  label (Read file) rather than the name the model calls it by
  (read_file);
- a cache of each provider's billing and plan quota kept fresh from
  `provider/quota-updated` events, and the helpers that show what a
  session, or a group of them such as a board's tasks, cost: a price
  when it is billed per token, the plan's name and quota when a
  subscription pays for it; and those that show budgets;
- faces and icons;
- window positions: one session per preset position, replacing, and
  the fullscreen layout, an overview such as the task board on the
  left of the frame and the session it inspects beside it; Emacs's
  window prefixes (C-x 4 4, C-x 5 5, C-x t t) win over both;
- the prefix keymap, the global minor mode and the transient menu,
  which also lists the commands of the buffer it is opened from, as
  that buffer's modes list them in their `harness-menu-group`.

## Provides

### Hooks

- `harness-ui-connected-hook` — Hook run once the UI has connected to a harness and initialised it.
- `harness-ui-event-functions` — Functions called with (EVENT ARGS) for every `_harness/event` notification.
- `harness-ui-live-functions` — Functions called with (SESSION-ID LIVE) after live token figures change.
- `harness-ui-notification-functions` — Functions called with (NOTIFICATION) when a desktop notification is clicked.
- `harness-ui-permission-functions` — Functions called with (PARAMS RESPOND) for `session/request_permission`.
- `harness-ui-prompt-functions` — Functions called with (SESSION-ID) after the prompts in flight to it changed.
- `harness-ui-question-functions` — Functions called with (PARAMS RESPOND) for `_harness/ask_user`.
- `harness-ui-quota-functions` — Functions called with (PROVIDER QUOTA) after PROVIDER's cached quota changes.
- `harness-ui-rate-functions` — Functions called with (SESSION-ID RATE) after a cached output rate changes.
- `harness-ui-redraw-hook` — Hook run when every UI buffer should redraw (after a reload or reconnect).
- `harness-ui-sessions-changed-hook` — Hook run after the session cache changes.
- `harness-ui-set-all-functions` — Functions called with KEY and VALUE when a command sets KEY everywhere.
- `harness-ui-update-functions` — Functions called with (SESSION-ID UPDATE) for every `session/update`.

### Commands

- `harness-cancel-turn` — Cancel the running turn of SESSION-ID.
- `harness-connect-remote` — Connect the UI to a harness ACP server at ADDRESS ("host:port").
- `harness-delete-session` — Delete SESSION-ID after confirmation.
- `harness-fork-session` — Fork SESSION-ID (default the current session) and open the fork in POSITION.
- `harness-fullscreen` — Start or end the fullscreen layout of an anchor in the selected frame.
- `harness-move-session` — Move SESSION-ID to the working directory DIRECTORY, and to its project.
- `harness-new-session` — Start a new session in DIRECTORY and show it in POSITION.
- `harness-rename-session` — Rename SESSION-ID to NAME.
- `harness-restart` — Restart the harness process with the current configuration.
- `harness-set-context-limit` — Change the context window limit of SESSION-ID.
- `harness-set-model` — Choose a model for SESSION-ID (default the current buffer's session).
- `harness-set-model-all` — Choose a model and switch every current session and task to it.
- `harness-set-non-interactive-all` — Turn non-interactive mode on or off for everything at once.
- `harness-set-permission-mode` — Choose the permission mode for SESSION-ID.
- `harness-set-thinking` — Choose a thinking level for SESSION-ID.
- `harness-set-thinking-all` — Choose a thinking level and set it on every current session and task.
- `harness-show-log` — Show the harness log buffer.
- `harness-switch-session` — Switch to another session, replacing the one in POSITION.
- `harness-test-notifications` — Check the notification setup with a test notification.
- `harness-toggle-non-interactive` — Toggle non-interactive mode for SESSION-ID.
- `harness-ui-action-push` — Run the action of the button at point, or at the position of mouse EVENT.
- `harness-ui-bury` — Put this buffer out of sight, bringing back what its window showed before.
- `harness-ui-context-limit-click` — Change the context limit of the session whose token figure EVENT clicked.
- `harness-ui-quit-view` — Put this view out of sight, bringing back what its window showed before.
- `harness-ui-show-usage` — Show the usage dashboard: costs, the plan's quota and the budgets.

### Options

- `harness-ui-default-position` — Position used when a session is opened without an explicit one.
- `harness-ui-fullscreen-side` — Side of the frame the fullscreen layout's anchor sits on.
- `harness-ui-fullscreen-width` — Width of the anchor in the fullscreen layout.
- `harness-ui-image-colors` — Colours images are drawn in: (FOREGROUND . BACKGROUND), or nil.
- `harness-ui-image-load-delay` — Seconds between drawing the images a view is loading.
- `harness-ui-image-max-height` — Maximum pixel height of inline images in harness views.
- `harness-ui-positions` — Named positions a session can be displayed in.
- `harness-ui-prefix-key` — Prefix key of `harness-ui-map` in `harness-global-mode`.
- `harness-ui-switch-project-function` — Function switching to a project before a session of it shows, or nil.
